title: "Interactive charts in Quarto posts"
date: 2026-07-04
categories: [quarto, data viz, meta]
description: >
  This site now supports interactive charts in posts —
  here's a tiny Observable JS example and how to write one.
---

This site can embed interactive charts with zero site-level JavaScript,
using Quarto's built-in [Observable JS](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/ojs/) engine.
Drag the slider:

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof amplitude = Inputs.range([0.5, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Amplitude"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  height: 260,
  y: {domain: [-3, 3]},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(
      d3.range(0, 20, 0.1).map(x => ({x, y: amplitude * Math.sin(x)})),
      {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "#F26522", strokeWidth: 2}
    )
  ]
})
```

## How to do this again

1. Add an `{ojs}` code cell to any post — no YAML changes needed.
2. `Inputs.*` makes controls; `Plot.plot` draws charts; `viewof` wires them together.
3. Everything runs in the reader's browser — the site stays static.
